physicalOutputsOmittedReason: Bounded native packets, child outputs and process identities remain in local controlled artifacts; the public record retains digests and synthetic acceptance ledgers.
installedArtifactScope: The tarball digest identifies the production installation used by the same nine external callbacks. ciOnlyFollowUp.scope: The exact Node image index is selected from a verified public mirror for task-storage and MCP Tasks CI. The JVM production engine, schemas and native fixtures measured here are unchanged.

ciImageDeliveryFollowUp.scope: The workflow and JVM validation Dockerfile select the byte-verified public mirrors of their original immutable image-index digests. This follows the observed registry failures before native execution.

nativeDeliveryAcceptance.scope: The same nine native callbacks passed against current source and a fresh offline production install rebuilt from the mirrored exact bases. The previously captured 21 compiling controls and 29 preserved callbacks retain unchanged engine/schema/fixture byte bindings.
